notes: Primary source: official Denon Professional cut sheet (soundapproach.com-hosted PDF, matches denonpro.com product page content) — "DN-500BDMKII-Cut-Sheet.pdf". Cross-checked against denonpro.com/products/dn-500bdmkii and Denon Pro support FAQ. All analog/digital audio outputs, XLR, RJ-45, RS-232C, and IEC power are directly and explicitly itemized in the official spec sheet's "Outputs" list, giving high confidence on those. Caveats: (1) The 7.1ch RCA output channel labels (Front L/R, Center, Sub, Surround L/R, Surround Back L/R) are the conventional 7.1 assignment; the spec sheet itemizes only "(8) RCA audio outputs (7.1 surround sound)" without printing individual per-jack labels, so exact rear-panel silkscreen text could not be confirmed. (2) HDMI version is not stated on the official cut sheet itself ("HDMI audio/visual output" with no version); HDMI 1.4/HDCP 1.4 is referenced in Denon's own support FAQ and third-party manual sources, so the hdmi-1.4 grade is inferred, not confirmed on the primary source — flagged accordingly. (3) The coaxial digital output uses AES/EBU signal format over what the datasheet calls a "coaxial" (RCA-type) connector — mapped to the rca connector id since there is no separate BNC/coax-digital id in the allowed list and RCA is the physical jack type used for coaxial digital audio in consumer/pro-lite gear. (4) USB port count/location: Denon's support FAQ confirms USB exists on both front and rear panels, but the official cut sheet's itemized "Outputs" list under Audio/Video does not separately list a rear USB jack (front-loading USB/SD are described as media-input slots in the overview text) — modeled as a single generic USB-A input port; exact rear-panel port count not fully verified. No separate digital audio grade scale exists for coax/AES so none was set (correctly omitted per rules, since RCA is not one of the graded connector types).

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: Official spec sheet lists only "HDMI audio/visual output" without a version number; HDMI 1.4 (3D) / HDCP 1.4 support is stated in secondary Denon support/manual sources, so version is inferred rather than confirmed on the primary spec sheet.

ports.name: Coaxial Digital Out
ports.note: Digital audio output, AES/EBU signal format, 0.5V/75-ohm coaxial (RCA) connector per official spec sheet.

ports.name: 7.1ch Analog Out (Front L)
ports.note: One of (8) discrete RCA outputs for 7.1-channel surround analog audio.

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: Ethernet: 10 Mbps / Fast Ethernet 100 Mbps per official spec sheet.

ports.name: RS-232C
ports.note: 9-pin D-Sub female, full duplex, 9600/38400 bps selectable.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Mass-storage USB port confirmed on both front and rear panels per Denon support FAQ (rear-panel presence not itemized in the cut-sheet's Outputs list); used for playback of media files, up to 2TB drives.
